detail.description:
Title: NutriScan AI — Food Intelligence & Allergen Guard

Short Description: A multi-modal food intelligence API for AI agents. Instantly analyze products via barcode, label photo, or ingredient text to get health scores, allergen warnings, and diet compatibility.

Long Description: NutriScan AI is a powerful Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents "eyes" and "expertise" in the grocery aisle. It bridges the gap between raw product data (Open Food Facts/USDA) and actionable nutritional intelligence.

Key Capabilities:
Multi-Modal Input: Seamlessly switch between barcode lookup (UPC/EAN), OCR-powered label image analysis, and raw ingredient list text.
Health Scoring: Instant Nutri-Score (A-F) grading and NOVA processing level classification (1-4).
Advanced Allergen Guard: Multi-stage detection for 10+ major allergen groups, using a proprietary blend of database tags, heuristics, and LLM reasoning to catch hidden derivatives.
Diet Compatibility: Automated verification for Vegan, Vegetarian, Keto, Paleo, Gluten-Free, Diabetic-friendly, Halal, and Kosher diets.
Smart Alternatives: Context-aware suggestions for healthier swaps when a product scores poorly.
Agent-Optimized: Designed specifically for AI agents (Claude, GPT, Cursor) with structured JSON outputs and descriptive tool schemas.

Use Cases:
"Scan this box of cereal and tell me if it's safe for a child with a peanut allergy."
"Analyze these ingredients and estimate the Nutri-Score."
"Is this snack compatible with a Paleo diet? If not, suggest a healthier swap."

tools.name: nutriscan_scan_barcode
tools.description: Look up a food or consumer product by its barcode (UPC/EAN) and get a complete nutritional intelligence report. Returns: health grade (A-F), ingredient analysis in plain English, allergen detection (CONTAINS/MAY_CONTAIN/UNLIKELY for gluten, dairy, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, eggs, fish, shellfish, sesame), diet compatibility (vegan, vegetarian, keto, paleo, gluten-free, diabetic-friendly, etc.), processing level (NOVA 1-4), and healthier alternative suggestions. Use this when a user wants to know if a product is safe for their diet or allergies.

barcode.description: Product barcode — UPC-A (12 digits), EAN-13 (13 digits), or EAN-8 (8 digits). Example: '016000275690' for Cheerios.

check_diets.description: List of diets to check compatibility. Options: vegan, vegetarian, keto, paleo, gluten_free, diabetic_friendly, low_fodmap, halal, kosher.

check_allergens.description: List of allergens to check. Options: gluten, dairy, peanuts, tree_nuts, soy, eggs, fish, shellfish, sesame. Defaults to all.

include_alternatives.description: Whether to suggest healthier alternatives if the product scores C, D, or E.

tools.name: nutriscan_analyze_text
tools.description: Analyze a raw ingredient list (as text) and get a nutritional intelligence report. Use this when you have the ingredient text but no barcode — e.g. from a photo of a label, a user typing ingredients, or an extracted ingredient list. Returns the same report as nutriscan_scan_barcode: health grade, ingredient explanations in plain English, allergen detection, and diet compatibility.

check_diets.description: List of diets to check compatibility.

check_allergens.description: List of allergens to check. Options: gluten, dairy, peanuts, tree_nuts, soy, eggs, fish, shellfish, sesame.

ingredients_text.description: The ingredients list as a comma-separated string. Example: 'whole wheat flour, sugar, palm oil, salt, mixed tocopherols'

tools.name: nutriscan_check_allergens
tools.description: Fast allergen-only check for a product barcode or ingredient list. Returns only allergen status — faster and cheaper than a full scan. Use this when you only need to know if a product is safe for a specific allergy and don't need the full nutritional breakdown.

allergens.description: Allergens to check. Options: gluten, dairy, peanuts, tree_nuts, soy, eggs, fish, shellfish, sesame.

ingredients_text.description: Raw ingredient list (optional if barcode provided).
